name: Miko☆Kami ~Docchi ni Suru no?~
original_name: みこ☆かみ ～どっちにするの?～
source:
Brother, what does it mean? 

Young Shinto shrine maidens get a share of their brother's love at home, company office and even during the festival.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-december-2007-dies-irae.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
哥哥，這是什麼意思？

年輕的神道巫女們在家中、公司辦公室，甚至祭典期間，都能分得哥哥的愛。

［來自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-december-2007-dies-irae.html]vndbreview[/url]］
